title: Pop-out during PR review returns to PR search screen instead of the active PR
scope:
# Summary

In the git integration, popping out a window while reviewing a PR loses the review context — the popped-out window returns to the PR search screen instead of showing the PR that was being reviewed.

# Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the git integration.
2. Start a review of a specific PR.
3. Click "pop out" to detach the review into its own window.

Expected: The popped-out window shows the PR that was being reviewed, preserving the current context/navigation state.
Actual: The popped-out window returns to the PR search screen.

# Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Popping out during an active PR review opens the popped-out window on the same PR
- [ ] Review navigation/context state is preserved in the popped-out window (not reset to search)
- [ ] The original (source) window behavior is unchanged

# Dev Hints

* The popped-out window likely isn't passed the currently selected PR / review state on creation. Investigate how the pop-out window is spawned and initialized, and ensure the active PR/review context is handed through to it.
